title: Warehouse Management and Fulfilment Competitive Landscape

scope.description: Warehouse management software competing with Picqer for webshops, wholesalers and fulfilment companies running their own warehouse, mainly in the Netherlands and Belgium, plus international e-commerce WMS and inventory platforms buyers compare against.
scope.inclusionLogic: Included: cloud WMS or inventory/order platforms sold to the same segments (webshops, wholesalers, fulfilment companies/3PLs) that buyers name as alternatives, including European ERP suites whose warehouse apps are bought instead of a dedicated WMS (Odoo Inventory, JTL-WMS). Excluded: shipping platforms that Picqer integrates with (Sendcloud, MyParcel, DeliveryMatch), Katapull siblings (Logic4's warehouse functions are positioned as a step below Picqer, not a competitor), and enterprise WMS for large logistics providers, which are not modeled in depth.
scope.notes: Figures are company-reported with each company's own scope and are not comparable to Picqer's claims (10% of Dutch online orders, 80+ fulfilment companies). Fetched 30-31 October 2026.

players.name: Monta (MontaWMS)
players.description: E-commerce fulfilment provider that also sells its own WMS (MontaWMS) and shipping platform (MontaShip). Competes for webshops deciding between running their own warehouse and outsourcing; MontaShip is also listed as a Picqer shipping integration.

businessStats.scope: Fulfilment warehouses in NL, DE, UK and FR, company-reported
Years MontaWMS has run Monta's own warehouses, company-reported

players.name: GoedGepickt
players.description: Dutch warehouse software for webshops and fulfilment companies with their own warehouse; the most direct like-for-like alternative to Picqer for small and mid-size webshops.

businessStats.scope: Webshops whose orders are processed daily, company-reported
Connected sales and shipping platforms, company-reported

players.name: Davanti-WICS (Corax WMS)
players.description: Dutch WMS vendor with WICS for B2B/B2C logistics and Corax, a 100% cloud WMS on Microsoft Azure aimed at e-commerce and fulfilment parties; competes at the upper end of Picqer's range.

businessStats.scope: Founding years of the two merged companies, company-reported
Combined logistics experience and expertise ('ruim 60 jaar'), company-reported
Continents where the company is active (HQ in NL, partners in Europe, US and Australia), company-reported

players.name: ShipHero
players.description: E-commerce WMS founded in 2013 for brands and 3PLs, also running its own fulfilment network; a benchmark for 3PL-focused WMS features such as billing and pack-to-light, with limited presence in the Benelux.

businessStats.scope: Shipments handled annually by warehouses on ShipHero, company-reported

players.name: Linnworks
players.description: Multichannel inventory and order management platform with warehouse and shipping functions; competes with Picqer for multichannel sellers wanting one hub for listings, stock and orders rather than a dedicated WMS.

businessStats.scope: Brands and retailers, company-reported; 20 years in business

players.name: Mintsoft (Access Group)
players.description: Cloud order and warehouse management system for 3PLs and e-commerce brands, part of The Access Group since 2020; competes with Picqer for fulfilment companies needing a 3PL client portal, client billing and many marketplace/shop integrations.

businessStats.scope: Integrations with sales channels and couriers, company-reported (FAQ elsewhere on the page says 170+ pre-built API integrations)
Customers at the time of acquisition by The Access Group, as stated by founder Luke Groves; founded 2011
businessStats.sourceTitle: The Access Group acquires Mintsoft Ltd

players.name: Odoo (Inventory / Barcode)
players.description: Belgian open-source modular ERP whose Inventory and Barcode apps cover multi-warehouse stock, picking routes and scanning; Benelux SMBs often choose it as an all-in-one alternative to a dedicated WMS like Picqer, usually via implementation partners.

businessStats.scope: Users worldwide across all Odoo apps and editions, company-reported (not WMS-specific)

players.name: JTL-Software (JTL-WMS)
players.description: German merchant suite whose JTL-WMS runs on top of the JTL-Wawi ERP with scanner-driven picking, packing and fulfilment-network functions; an alternative for cross-border webshops selling into Germany that want ERP and warehouse in one stack.

businessStats.scope: JTL merchant community as stated on homepage
